about.text: A reviewer's comment on the two 813 mm doors, the near-threshold failures (37 mm under the rule). camera holds where the reviewer stood, east of the building and above it, looking at the middle of the two doors' union box; review turns it into the issue's camera columns and holds the two doors' GlobalIds, the texts, the author and the time. answer shows the issue, one row per door; topics previews the topic; bcf writes artifacts/checking/s14-door-bcf-review.bcf only when you press Run, with the comment under the topic and the viewpoint at this camera.

review.title: 813 mm doors: 37 mm under the 850 mm rule
review.description: The two glazed exterior doors (M_Single-Glass 1, type 0813 x 2420mm) have an OverallWidth of 813 mm; rule DC-W1 asks for at least 850 mm.
review.comment: Both doors miss the 850 mm minimum by 37 mm, the smallest shortfall on the project. Please widen the leaf or confirm an exemption.
review.author: Reviewer

answer.title: The reviewer's issue, one row per door
